objective: Standard statement: for every three-fold space H (a connected cubic system that is not 2-colourable, so on Seymour's bound) and every line L, the number of colourings of H - L is computable in polynomial time: (1) it is twice the product of the brace amplitudes (THREEFOLD-AMPLITUDE A and C); (2) a planar brace's amplitude and leaning splits are counts of Tutte matchings, absolute values of weighted Berman determinants (sign coherence); (3) a non-planar Pfaffian brace other than the Heawood graph is a trisum tree of planar braces (Robertson-Seymour-Thomas), found in polynomial time; (4) bottom-up, every planar piece is one weighted determinant in which each child pair acts as row weights (ticket A); implement and confirm against direct counts on nested trisums and spaces with trisum glue. Nearest known result: Berman 1980; Tutte; Robertson-Seymour-Thomas 1999; Fisher-Kasteleyn-Temperley; Szeider 2004. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: #col(H - L) is computable in polynomial time on every three-fold space without any signing: braces by tight cuts, planar braces by Berman determinants, other braces by their trisum tree (Robertson-Seymour-Thomas trisectors), each branch's leaning split one weighted row-restricted determinant of its planar leaf (two per leaf), closed by the trisum law
title: Polynomial counting on Seymour's cubic bound
